tasks.title: Runner and execute API allow unauthenticated code execution
tasks.root_cause: The web execute route reads the session but does not require it, and the runner exposes POST /execute without a shared service credential while compose publishes runner port 8080.
tasks.where_it_fails: Unauthenticated callers can reach either /api/execute or the runner /execute endpoint and trigger Docker execution.
tasks.current_behavior: No session cookie or service token is required; code is executed and results are returned.
tasks.expected_behavior: User-facing execution requires an authenticated user session, and runner execution requires a server-side shared token from the web app.
tasks.proof_example: curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/execute -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"code":"def solution(x): return x","language":"python","test_cases":[{"id":"t1","input":"x = 1","expected_output":"1","is_hidden":false}],"time_limit_ms":2000,"memory_limit_kb":256000}'
tasks.fix_location: apps/web/src/app/api/execute/route.ts POST around lines 60-65 and 107-120; apps/runner/main.py execute_code around lines 69-103; compose.yml runner service around lines 80-85.
tasks.what_to_change: Require session.user.id before accepting /api/execute, send a shared runner token header from the web app, require that header in the runner, and stop exposing runner on all host interfaces in compose.
tasks.expected_result_after_fix: Unauthenticated /api/execute returns 401 before creating a submission, and direct /execute without the token returns 401 or 403 before any Docker container is created.
tasks.test_gap: No API or runner tests assert unauthenticated execution is rejected or runner token checks are enforced.
validation_commands: curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/execute -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"code":"def solution(x): return x","language":"python","test_cases":[{"id":"t1","input":"x = 1","expected_output":"1","is_hidden":false}],"time_limit_ms":2000,"memory_limit_kb":256000}'

manual_user_test.where_to_test: http://localhost:3000 problem editor and direct runner endpoint http://localhost:8080/execute if the runner is intentionally published locally.
steps: Run docker compose up --build -d.
Send the proof curl directly to the runner without the token.
Send POST /api/execute without a logged-in browser session.
Log in and run code from a problem editor.
manual_user_test.expected_result: Direct runner calls without the token fail with 401/403, unauthenticated web calls fail with 401, and authenticated editor execution still works through the web service.
regression_checks: Runner health remains available at /health.
The web service can still call the runner when RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET matches.
No submission row is created for unauthenticated web execution.

tasks.title: Timed-out runner containers are killed but never removed
tasks.root_cause: Timeout path kills and returns before remove() is reached.
tasks.current_behavior: Exited executor containers accumulate after TLE.
tasks.expected_behavior: Execution containers are removed on success, error, and timeout.
tasks.proof_example: Submit an infinite loop with time_limit_ms=100 then run docker ps -a --filter ancestor=grindup-executor --filter status=exited.
tasks.what_to_change: Move container removal into a finally using remove(force=True).
tasks.expected_result_after_fix: The proof does not show new leftover containers.
tasks.test_gap: No runner timeout cleanup test exists.

steps: Submit an infinite loop with a tiny time limit.
Inspect exited executor containers.
manual_user_test.expected_result: No new stopped executor container remains.
regression_checks: Normal accepted and wrong-answer submissions still return results.

tasks.suggested_commit_message: Fix runner container cleanup on timeout

tasks.title: Runner execute handler blocks the event loop during Docker work
tasks.root_cause: An async FastAPI handler directly runs synchronous Docker SDK work and polling.
tasks.current_behavior: One execution can delay health checks and concurrent requests.
tasks.expected_behavior: Docker work runs off the event loop.
tasks.proof_example: Start a slow /execute request then immediately run time curl -s http://localhost:8080/health.
tasks.what_to_change: Use run_in_threadpool or make the route sync so FastAPI offloads Docker work.
tasks.expected_result_after_fix: /health responds quickly while execution is running.

steps: Run a long execution.
Call /health while it runs.
regression_checks: Execution response shape is unchanged.

tasks.suggested_commit_message: Move runner Docker execution off the event loop

tasks.title: Submission queue claim can hand one job to concurrent workers
tasks.root_cause: getNextJob reads then updates a queued job without an atomic claim predicate or row lock.
tasks.current_behavior: Two workers can receive the same job.
tasks.expected_behavior: Exactly one worker claims one queued job.
tasks.proof_example: Run Promise.all([getNextJob(), getNextJob()]) after queueing one job and compare returned ids.
tasks.what_to_change: Use an atomic claim operation with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED or an updateMany claim predicate plus retry.
tasks.expected_result_after_fix: Only one worker receives the queued job.

steps: Queue one job.
Run two claim calls concurrently.
manual_user_test.expected_result: Only one claim returns the queued job id.
regression_checks: Single-worker claims still work.

tasks.title: Shared submission contract does not match the execute APIs
tasks.owner_agent_name: Clean Code and Compatibility Agent - Minimalist Maintainer
tasks.root_cause: Shared execution types use camelCase and advertise csharp while live APIs use snake_case and runner supports fewer languages.
tasks.where_it_fails: Clients typed against @grindup/shared can send payloads the web route rejects.
tasks.current_behavior: A shared SubmissionRequest-shaped payload returns missing fields.
tasks.expected_behavior: Shared contracts match accepted JSON and supported languages.
tasks.proof_example: curl -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/execute -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"code":"def solution(): return 1","language":"python","problemId":"any","testCases":[],"timeLimitMs":2000,"memoryLimitKb":256000}'
tasks.what_to_change: Align shared types with canonical web API shape or accept both shapes through a compatibility adapter and remove csharp until supported.
tasks.expected_result_after_fix: Payload shape fails only for domain reasons, not shared-contract field mismatch.

manual_user_test.where_to_test: Shared execution types, POST /api/execute, and the problem editor execution flow.
steps: Run shared lint and the web typecheck.
Confirm TypeScript rejects csharp and the old camelCase SubmissionRequest shape.
Run editor execution while logged in.
Optionally post an authenticated snake_case payload to /api/execute.
manual_user_test.expected_result: Old shared-contract payloads fail at compile time, supported snake_case payloads are handled without Missing required fields, and editor execution still works.
regression_checks: Existing UI payload still uses snake_case.
The editor language picker still offers Python, JavaScript, Java, and C++.

tasks.suggested_commit_message: Align shared execution contract with runner API

tasks.title: Compose runner launches executor containers without shared execution files
tasks.root_cause: The compose runner creates execution files in a temp directory inside the runner container, then asks the host Docker daemon to bind-mount that container-internal path into a sibling executor container.
tasks.where_it_fails: Compose runner POST /execute launches an executor that cannot see /app/main.py.
tasks.current_behavior: The runner health check can pass, but real code execution through compose returns python3: can't open file '/app/main.py'.
tasks.expected_behavior: Compose /execute should make generated source files visible inside the executor container and return normal test results.
tasks.proof_example: curl -sS -i -m 15 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/execute -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Runner-Token: dev-only-runner-secret' --data '{"code":"def solution(x):\n    return x","language":"python","test_cases":[{"id":"t1","input":"x = 1","expected_output":"1","is_hidden":false}],"time_limit_ms":2000,"memory_limit_kb":256000}'
tasks.fix_location: compose.yml runner service volumes/environment around lines 80-86; apps/runner/services/docker_service.py DockerService.run_code around lines 23-50.
tasks.what_to_change: Use a host-visible execution work directory shared with the runner container, or use Docker volumes/archive-copy so executor input files are visible to sibling containers.
tasks.expected_result_after_fix: The proof curl returns status:"accepted" with one passing test result instead of an error opening /app/main.py.
tasks.test_gap: No compose smoke test calls runner /execute and asserts a simple accepted result.
validation_commands: curl -sS -i -m 15 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/execute -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Runner-Token: dev-only-runner-secret' --data '{"code":"def solution(x):\n    return x","language":"python","test_cases":[{"id":"t1","input":"x = 1","expected_output":"1","is_hidden":false}],"time_limit_ms":2000,"memory_limit_kb":256000}'

manual_user_test.where_to_test: Docker compose runner /execute endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:8080/execute.
steps: Run docker compose up --build -d runner or the full stack equivalent.
Check runner health with curl -sS -i -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:8080/health.

regression_checks: Runner /health remains healthy.

tasks.title: Runner offload can fan out unbounded Docker containers
tasks.root_cause: The event-loop fix offloads Docker execution into Starlette threadpool workers, but no runner-local concurrency limiter exists before containers.run.
tasks.where_it_fails: Bursts of authenticated runner /execute requests can start many executor containers in parallel.
tasks.current_behavior: Each accepted request can enter run_in_threadpool and create a Docker container without a configured cap.
tasks.expected_behavior: The runner enforces a documented maximum number of concurrent executor containers and rejects or queues excess work predictably.
tasks.proof_example: Start the compose stack, send 40 valid POST /execute requests with X-Runner-Token in parallel, then run docker ps --filter ancestor=grindup-executor:latest; many executor containers can be active at once.
tasks.fix_location: apps/runner/main.py execute_code around lines 95-130; optionally compose.yml runner environment around lines 80-84.
tasks.what_to_change: Add a runner-level concurrency limiter around the run_in_threadpool call, backed by an env var such as RUNNER_MAX_CONCURRENT_EXECUTIONS; return 429/503 or wait within a bounded timeout when saturated.
tasks.expected_result_after_fix: The parallel proof shows no more than the configured number of executor containers active, and excess requests get a clear backpressure response or bounded wait.
tasks.test_gap: No runner concurrency/load test asserts max active executor containers or backpressure behavior.
validation_commands: Run a parallel /execute burst and verify active grindup-executor containers never exceed RUNNER_MAX_CONCURRENT_EXECUTIONS.

manual_user_test.where_to_test: Runner /execute under compose or a local runner connected to Docker.
steps: Configure a small RUNNER_MAX_CONCURRENT_EXECUTIONS value.
Send a burst of valid /execute requests larger than that value.
Watch docker ps and response statuses.
manual_user_test.expected_result: Active executor containers never exceed the configured limit; overflow behavior is explicit and stable.
regression_checks: A single editor execution still succeeds.
Health checks remain responsive during a burst.
REL-002 event-loop responsiveness remains improved.

tasks.title: Execute route returns raw internal errors to authenticated callers
tasks.root_cause: The outer POST /api/execute catch block sends error.message and String(error) back to clients.
tasks.where_it_fails: Authenticated callers who trigger internal execute-route exceptions can receive implementation details in 500 responses.
tasks.current_behavior: The route can return a 500 body containing raw exception message and details.
tasks.expected_behavior: Clients receive a generic execution error while full details stay in server logs.
tasks.fix_location: apps/web/src/app/api/execute/route.ts outer catch in POST, lines 292-297.
tasks.what_to_change: Keep server-side logging, but return a generic body such as { error: "Internal server error", status: "error" } without error.message, error.stack, or String(error).
tasks.expected_result_after_fix: The proof still returns 500, but the body contains only a generic error and no Prisma/framework/internal details.
tasks.test_gap: No execute-route test asserts internal exceptions are sanitized before reaching API clients.
validation_commands: Run the proof request with an authenticated session and verify no raw internal error details are returned.

steps: Send the malformed authenticated proof request.
Inspect the response body.
Run a normal authenticated editor execution.
manual_user_test.expected_result: Malformed requests do not expose raw internal details; normal execution still returns its expected result shape.
regression_checks: Server logs still include enough detail for debugging.
Unauthenticated requests still return 401 before body parsing.
Runner error messages for user code remain useful where intentionally exposed.
